observations.quote: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee $250 billion in financing that would allow OpenAI to lease a data center being built in Ohio.
observations.one_line: 据《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达正在洽谈为OpenAI租赁俄亥俄州数据中心提供2500亿美元融资担保；安排尚在洽谈中。
observations.speaker: MarketWatch（转述《华尔街日报》报道）
observations.original_day: 2026-07-26（周日报道；原文未给出具体日期）

observations.quote: The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
observations.one_line: 《华尔街日报》称，俄亥俄州数据中心项目成本可能超过5000亿美元，将成为迄今宣布的最大数据中心项目。
observations.speaker: MarketWatch（转述《华尔街日报》报道）
observations.original_day: 2026-07-26（周日报道；原文未给出具体日期）

observations.quote: "I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
observations.one_line: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg表示，他不了解安排细节、也不确定其真实性，但若交易发生，他认为英伟达难以证明该安排合理。
observations.speaker: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg

observations.quote: Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
observations.one_line: Jay Goldberg指出，企业过去曾因融资支持客户购买而使自身陷入困境；他以Lucent的供应商融资为例，称该做法实质上摧毁了这家公司。
observations.speaker: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg

observations.quote: Shares of Nvidia lost 5% in Monday's trading.
observations.one_line: 英伟达股价在2026年7月27日星期一的交易中下跌5%。
observations.speaker: MarketWatch

observations.quote: The project is located on a decommissioned uranium-enrichment site, and the campus would require 10 gigawatts of electricity.
observations.one_line: 报道所述俄亥俄州数据中心项目位于已停用的铀浓缩设施旧址，园区运营需要10吉瓦电力。
observations.speaker: MarketWatch

observations.quote: The backing by Nvidia would enable SoftBank to raise debt on more favorable terms - which would otherwise be challenging given how S&P Global has flagged OpenAI as a key credit risk.
observations.one_line: MarketWatch称，英伟达提供支持可使软银以更有利条件融资；若无该支持，鉴于标普全球已将OpenAI标为关键信用风险，软银融资可能面临挑战。
observations.speaker: MarketWatch
observations.original_who: MarketWatch；其关于OpenAI信用风险的说法归于S&P Global
observations.event_time: 报道时；假设性交易安排

observations.quote: "Investor feedback late last night was a combination of this being the clearest/largest circular-financing headline we've seen so far and we're not entirely new to this circular-financing debacle," Jefferies technology strategist Jeffrey Favuzza said in a note to clients.
observations.one_line: Jefferies科技策略师Jeffrey Favuzza在客户报告中称，投资者认为这可能是迄今最明显、规模最大的循环融资消息之一，并指出市场此前已见过此类循环融资问题。
observations.speaker: Jefferies科技策略师Jeffrey Favuzza
observations.original_day: 2026-07-27（MarketWatch报道日；原文称“昨晚”，未提供具体日期）

observations.quote: In February, the Financial Times reported that Nvidia was pulling out from a $100 billion agreement originally announced in September, and replacing it with a $30 billion equity investment.
observations.one_line: MarketWatch转述《金融时报》报道称，英伟达于2026年2月退出此前在2025年9月宣布的1000亿美元协议，改为300亿美元股权投资。
observations.speaker: MarketWatch（转述《金融时报》报道）
